Case reference: 2014003765.CaseDesc: On the morning of August 11, 1994, Neil Hicks was seen for the last time leaving his temporary residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario. At the time of his disappearance Neil suffered from mental health issues.

Keith directed his neighbour to drop him off at the corner of Alsek Rd and Aishihik Rd, where he departed from the vehicle. Keith has not been seen or heard from since that drop off. Helicopter, drone, boat, ATV and foot searches throughout the area have been conducted but no signs of Keith have been found.

Case reference: 2020009588.CaseDesc: On February 8, 1989, at approximately 7:30am, Soekarmia Sarbirja was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Soekarmia was to attend an immigration hearing on February 10, but did not show up.

Case reference: 2008006798.CaseDesc: Jason Russell was last seen at the Casino in Niagara Falls. Jason was a student at Brock University in St. Catharines, Ontario.

Case reference: 2020007628.CaseDesc: On August 16, 1971, at approximately 8:30pm, Stephanie Rawlinson was last seen near 2801 Jane Street in Toronto, Ontario. Stephanie had left her home in a cab after getting into a disagreement.

Case reference: 2020021699.CaseDesc: Brian Jimmy was reported missing to the Lloydminster RCMP in Alberta on June 24, 2020. He was last seen on June 11 at the 7-Eleven convenience store on 44th Street in Lloydminster, Saskatchewan. The police are seeking the public's assistance in locating Brian and ascertaining his well-being.

The canoe capsized approximately 500 feet away from the campsite.

Case reference: 2022014288.CaseDesc: Lauren Craven was last seen by his family in Wildwood, Alberta on April 7th, 2022. Lauren's vehicle was located abandoned near Sparwood, British Columbia on August 26, 2022 with a Lethbridge Prairie Post newspaper dated June 17th, 2022. Lauren was showing signs of early-onset dementia.

Case reference: 2012020010.CaseDesc: Jacek Laskowski was reported missing on May 3, 2005, from Calgary, AB.  Information suggests that he may have been last seen in the Golden, BC area.

Case reference: 2019012891.CaseDesc: Dean Brett Todd was last seen by his brother, around Easter time in 2000, near First Memorial Services Kamloops (formerly Schoening Funeral Home) on Tranquille Road in Kamloops, British Columbia. Dean had been invited to dinner, but did not show up. Dean is known to travel between Kamloops and Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2013000046.CaseDesc: On June 27, 2004, Richard McGuire was seen for the last time in the Nouveau-Rosemont district of Montreal, Quebec. Richard's vehicle, a Ford Windstar, was later found in a garage located in the municipality of St-Elzear in the La Nouvelle-Beauce Regional County in Quebec.

Case reference: 2008003299.CaseDesc: On May 17, 1985, Cyril Cheong was fishing on White Lake with his friends when the weather deteriorated and strong winds started to blow. Cyril's boat capsized and his friends were unable to save him.  One of his friends saw him, approximately 2 to 3 feet under the water, beyond his reach.

Case reference: 2016061228.CaseDesc: On June 14, 1970, a male was found floating in Lake Ontario near the mouth of the Humber River. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 201lbs and his length was measured at 5'10", however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present. He is thought to have been in the water for a few days to several days.

Shoes: Black, only the left shoe has laces

Case reference: 2012020159.CaseDesc: In July 2004, the remains of an unidentified man were found on the shore of the Fraser River in Richmond, British Columbia. The man had good dental work and had a gold tooth in his left lower jaw. It is estimated that he may have died in 2003 or early 2004.

Case reference: 2013000111.CaseDesc: Clifford Sherwood and George Gumbley were last seen on October 21, 1954 in Montreal, Quebec in the Verdun neighbourhood, when they were together and walking to their school. On the way to school, they would have deviated from their usual route together on foot to an unknown destination. Their families never saw them again.

Case reference: 2018040713.CaseDesc: On January 30, 1996, at approximately 7:30am, William Chan was last seen when he dropped off his son at school in Toronto, Ontario.

Coat: Nylon, Black, Ski coat; Brand-North Face

Case reference: 2024061875.CaseDesc: On November 17, 2024, the Beaumont RCMP received a report that Shawn Edward Robson-Harder had not been seen in Beaumont since September 19, 2024. He had a history of frequenting major cities and First Nations throughout Alberta.  However, had never gone this long without checking in with friends. Shawn's friends and family are concerned for his well-being.

Case reference: 2012020085.CaseDesc: Benjamin Entz was born, raised and lived on the Waldeck Hutterite Colony near Waldeck, Saskatchewan up until the time of his disappearance. His friends and family describe him as a very withdrawn individual. He left the colony the evening of September 18, 2011 on a tractor that was recovered the following day. The investigation/search for Benjamin has included numerous witness interviews, air and ground searches, and media releases, however he has yet to be located.

Case reference: 2023063442.CaseDesc: On November 18, 2023, Lindsay Woods was reported missing by his parents, as he had not returned to his home in Prince Albert, Saskatchewan, since November 15. It was reported that he was feeling despondent when he left home. Despite extensive efforts, Lindsay's whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014006028.CaseDesc: On January 18th, 2013, the Teton family checked into the New Otani Inn, located in Yokohama, Japan.  This was to be the final destination before returning to Canada.  While Henrik was in the shower, his wife Chieko and 1 year old son Takaya vanished. Henrik sought the assistance of police in Yokohama and the Canadian Embassy, to no avail. Shortly thereafter, Henrik attended 52 Division to report the incident and his subsequent attempt to locate his family. Toronto Police requested the assistance of Japanese police to confirm Chieko’s and Takaya’s well-being and Chieko’s intentions.  It was confirmed that both are in good health and that Chieko does not wish her whereabouts be disclosed.

Case reference: 2025004300.CaseDesc: Vikas Sharma's last sighting was on January 25, 2025 in the area of Table Rock, Niagara Falls, Ontario.

Jewelry: Silver, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Ring, With a clear stone
Silver, Silver, Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Bracelet

Case reference: 2011002399.CaseDesc: Cynthia Sunga was last seen at her family home on Donald Street in Ottawa, Ontario, on or about August 25, 2005.  Cynthia was reported missing to the Ottawa Police on November 11, 2005, by a family member.  We have been unable to make contact with her since that time.

Tattoo: Lower Back, Tribal heart - Chinese characters for strong

Case reference: 2014004721.CaseDesc: Belinda Gertrude Williams was last seen by her sister and father in July 1976, in Vancouver, British Columbia. Case reference: 2014004068.CaseDesc: Alexandra Sawicki disappeared from her home in Mississauga, Ontario, on November 13, 2000. She was driving a burgundy 1998 Dodge Neon with 4 doors. Case reference: 2012020079.CaseDesc: On September 26, 1991, Lavina Tocher was last seen in Parkman, Saskatchewan. On the 12th of December of that year, she was reported missing. Investigation and searches have failed to locate her.

Case reference: 2014001392.CaseDesc: On March 31, 1994, Kuldip Singh was seen for the last time in Brampton, Ontario.  There is a possibility that Kuldip may be in the United States.

There are no indications to suggest any foul play.

Case reference: 2014004476.CaseDesc: Gayebrella King was reported missing by her family on May 8, 1980. She was last seen in Edmonton, Alberta in late August 1978.

Case reference: 2014004201.CaseDesc: Rodney Hicks was last seen at his residence at 1700hrs on March 3, 1989. Mr. Hicks has an intellectual disability. He suffered from epilepsy and autism.

Case reference: 2018043199.CaseDesc: In December of 1995, Myung Lim was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Myung and his wife had an argument and he told her he was returning to South Korea.

Case reference: 1996000260.CaseDesc: On March 17, 1995, Jay Boyle, Michael Cummings, Daniel Higgins, Jamie Lefebvre, Robert Rumbolt, and Chad Smith were seen for the last time walking towards the East Shore Marina in Pickering, Ontario. Yves may have been spotted a few times, however he has had no contact with his family since this date. The family of Yves have reasons to fear for his health and safety.

Case reference: 2025022621.CaseDesc: At 10:01 a.m., on May 2nd, 2025, Jack and Lilly Sullivan were reported missing from their rural home on Gairloch Road, in Lansdowne, Nova Scotia. Jack and Lilly’s mother reported the children had last been seen that morning at approximately 7:00 a.m. - 7:30 a.m., and were noticed missing from the house at approximately 9:40 a.m. Extensive search initiatives began immediately utilizing RCMP, GSAR, Air Services, Police Dog Services and drones but have yielded negative results thus far.

Case reference: 2018056500.CaseDesc: On August 2 1997, Ronald Halpern was last seen leaving his residence to go to the Toronto International Airport. Ronald boarded a flight traveling to the Dominican Republic.

He did not return in the Fall and his family reported him missing. It was later discovered that he had never made it there.

Scar: Report only indicates "body scars"; no location indicated

Case reference: 2017061282.CaseDesc: Andrew Fraser was last seen near the falls in Niagara Falls, Ontario, on March 23, 1999.

Case reference: 2020018331.CaseDesc: Riley Berland went missing from Frog Lake, Alberta, on May 31, 2020. Riley's family has not seen or heard from him since this time.

Case reference: 2012020140.CaseDesc: Melina Martin of Sainte-Sabine, Quebec was last seen on January 23, 2005 at 1:30 p.m. in the Roch-Bourbonnais park in Farnham, Quebec.

Case reference: 2014002297.CaseDesc: On May 25, 1983, Dean Martin was seen for the last time at a cottage on Mount Carleton in Carleton-sur-Mer, Quebec. He left the cottage without leaving a note or informing anyone. Dean has not been seen or heard from since.

The numbers visible on the surgical plates could not be traced to a specific individual, however, it was determined that the lot was released some time after May 25, 1994. A MacDonald’s name tag with the name "Raymond" was found in the sewer, which may or may not be related to this individual.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Hip, recent fracture of left hip

On the morning of November 5, 1966, a police unit led the search of the area with 35 citizens and two aircrafts. The search was completed on November 15, 1966, with negative results and no evidence as to the circumstances of his disappearance.

Shirt: Wool, Red, Black, Checkered heavy doe skin

Case reference: 2019009156.CaseDesc: Yves Guérin was last seen in January 1991, when he left his residence in Montréal, Quebec.

Case reference: 2006022499.CaseDesc: Witold Sagin was last seen while fishing on Gordon Lake. He was fishing in a canoe, which was later found overturned. He is presumed drowned.

The sacrum was deformed and there is a possibility that he walked with a limp.

Case reference: 2015069712.CaseDesc: On November 15, 2015, at approximately 1:00 p.m., Blake McCool was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Despite extensive search efforts, Pooran and his aircraft remain missing.

Case reference: 2006017199.CaseDesc: Mistie Murray was last seen on May 31, 1995, in the Goderich area.

Teeth: Space between her two upper front teeth

Case reference: 2014005122.CaseDesc: On May 27, 2008, Phillip Morin was last seen in the Colony Street area of Winnipeg, Manitoba.

A large number of volunteers walked the shoreline and boat patrols failed to locate him. It is assumed Kelsey drowned.

Case reference: 2014004580.CaseDesc: On the morning of July 23, 1991, a group of 8 individuals left Igloolik, Nunavut and headed to Hall Beach, Nunavut. It was a stormy day with heavy rain and approximately 24 km north of Hall Beach, the canoe hit ice, filled with water and capsized.  Only one occupant made it back to shore.

Case reference: 2007004799.CaseDesc: Stacy Dilenardi was last seen on November 28, 2005, purchasing some cigarettes at a gas bar in Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario (Garden River). He had just moved to Sault Ste. Marie and had recently started a job as a technician with the Ontario Forest Research Institute. Stacy had spoken to his father the day before his disappearance. On November 30, 2005, investigators located his vehicle north of the city on a snowmobile trail.

Case reference: 2014005315.CaseDesc: Darryl Dubitski was last seen by his family leaving his residence in Edmonton, Alberta in December of 1982. Darryl had informed his family that he was travelling to the United States.

Case reference: 2014001816.CaseDesc: On November 14, 1981, Wayne Martin was seen for the last time while he was out for a walk at the Rideau Heights Campground in Ottawa, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014006374.CaseDesc: Rosalie Jean ALLAN was last seen at the end of November, start of December 2013, in Abbotsford, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014004457.CaseDesc: Stephon Payne was last seen at his residence on October 6, 2002. On the same day, Stephon was seen in the area of 106 Avenue and 84 Street, Edmonton, Alberta. Alf told his wife he would be returning on either October 22nd or 23rd 1996. He indicated he was meeting a business associate in London, however it was later confirmed there were no scheduled business meetings with this particular individual, who hadn't seen Alf since the previous year. Alf flew to England on October 17, 1996 and was confirmed to have flown into Toronto airport on October 19, 1996, via British Airways. Alf has not been seen nor heard from since this date and his family and police are concerned for his safety and well-being.

Case reference: 2006020999.CaseDesc: Ivan Matthews was last seen when witnesses saw his sailboat out of control approximately one mile off shore near the Sand Islands in Lake Superior. It is presumed that he fell overboard and he hasn't been seen since.

Susan was suffering from dementia and had a recent history of becoming lost. The area surrounding her home is rural and wooded with a large rapid river nearby.

Case reference: 2018063460.CaseDesc: On October 13, 1992, at approximately 8:30 am, Debra Kumar was last seen in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2017009362.CaseDesc: Badri Prasad Bhattarai, was reported missing on February 21, 2017, after his family became concerned that he had not been in contact with them. Case reference: 2014045101.CaseDesc: The partial remains of an older adult female were found near Chasm, British Colombia in 2010. She had no teeth in her lower jaw and had likely gone missing many years earlier.

Case reference: 2014005103.CaseDesc: On May 22, 2008, Mathieu Duguay was seen for the last time while shouting for help in Rivière-des-Prairies in Montreal, Quebec. Case reference: 2014006175.CaseDesc: On July 8, 2013, at approximately 5:30 a.m., Jason Bathily and his twin sister, Clarene Bathily, were seen for the last time with their mother, Adelyne Mounga, in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2016068715.CaseDesc: On July 21, 2013, the body of an adult male was found floating in the Niagara River across from the Youngstown Marina, NY, USA near the Niagara-On-The-Lake Sailing Club, Ontario, Canada. Case reference: 2014002353.CaseDesc: On June 2, 1978, two men found a racing canoe and called the police. During the ensuing investigation, it was discovered that there were two men in the canoe, apparently on their way to dig for Seneca root on Moose Lake in Manitoba. According to witnesses who saw the men leave, they left in adverse weather conditions, including high winds. Reuban has not been located and his whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2012020087.CaseDesc: James Carlson was last seen between 7:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m. on 5 May 2010 at a local business in Watrous, Saskatchewan. His 1985 Chevrolet Monte Carlo was found nearly 125 kilometres north in a rural area south of Rosthern Sk. Police have yet to locate James.
